d:
Aur mere chatoro, kaise ho aap - Bombay Style me Paneer Toast Sandwich Banane ki recipe share kar raha hu, ye bhai super bante hai ekdam chatpate aur tasty, bilkul bhi feeke nai lagenge, aap bhi try kariega 15 minute me ready ho jaega, aur jyada kuch ready nai karna padta hai, fatafat masala banega aur bread me toast karna hai :)
Ingredients for 4 Sandwich Toast
Paneer - 200gm
Pyaaz - 3 medium size
Hari mirch - 3
Hara Dhania - handful
Namak - to taste
Chat masala - 1 tsp
